headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 1, 2026**
article:
The New York Yankees secured a shutout victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Will Warren pitching 6.2 innings of scoreless baseball. Spencer Jones led the Yankees' offense with a home run and 1 RBI. In other action, the Cincinnati Reds edged out the Pittsburgh Pirates 8-7 in a closely contested matchup, while the Toronto Blue Jays took down the St. Louis Cardinals 3-1.

Several key players have been affected by injuries. Luke Raley of the Seattle Mariners has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left forearm strain. The Minnesota Twins have transferred Mike Paredes from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a left oblique strain. Other injured players include Brock Stewart of the Los Angeles Dodgers, Matt Vierling of the Detroit Tigers, J.P. Crawford of the Seattle Mariners, Cionel Pérez of the New York Mets, Shane McClanahan of the Tampa Bay Rays, and Gavin Hollowell of the Chicago Cubs.

The Milwaukee Brewers have bolstered their pitching staff with the addition of Codi Heuer, acquired in a trade with the Cleveland Guardians. Heuer joins the Brewers along with catcher Bo Naylor, while outfielder Blake Perkins and right-hander Craig Yoho head to the Guardians. The Baltimore Orioles have traded RHP Dean Kremer to the Minnesota Twins for OF Jhomnardo Reyes, and the New York Mets have traded LHP A.J. Minter to the Minnesota Twins for SS Bruin Agbayani and 3B Billy Amick.

top_news.title: **Yankees Shut Down Cubs 2-0**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a shutout victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Will Warren pitching 6.2 innings of scoreless baseball. Spencer Jones led the Yankees' offense with a home run and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Reds Rally Past Pirates in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds edged out the Pittsburgh Pirates 8-7 in a closely contested matchup. Sal Stewart led the Pirates' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Phillies Fall Short in Baltimore**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies dropped a 4-6 decision to the Baltimore Orioles, unable to overcome a strong Orioles offense. Pete Alonso led the Phillies with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Blue Jays 3-1**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays took down the St. Louis Cardinals 3-1, securing a crucial win. Luis Urías led the Cardinals' offense with a single, 2 RBI, and 1 AB.

top_news.title: **Mariners Place Raley on 10-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Seattle Mariners right fielder Luke Raley has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left forearm strain, effective retroactive to July 31, 2026.

top_news.title: **Brewers Bolster Bullpen with Heuer Acquisition**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers have strengthened their pitching staff with the addition of right-handed pitcher Codi Heuer, acquired in a trade with the Cleveland Guardians. Heuer joins the Brewers along with catcher Bo Naylor, while outfielder Blake Perkins and right-hander Craig Yoho head to the Guardians.
